items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: easy-vibe
items.summary: Easy-Vibe 是一门面向初学者的现代编程课程，通过 AI 辅助编码让零基础用户也能逐步掌握 Web 开发。其核心特色是将低代码理念与 GPT、DeepSeek 等大模型结合，利用 Next.js 和 MCP 协议在自然语言与代码之间搭建桥梁，让学习者能直接构建真实应用。课程设计强调从想法到原型的快速迭代，特别适合非程序员或想了解 AI Agent 的新手。你可以用它来快速验证创意，或学习如何将 AI 融入日常开发流程。
items.summary_en: Easy-Vibe is a beginner-friendly programming course that teaches modern web development through AI-assisted coding. It uniquely combines low-code principles with LLM tools like GPT and DeepSeek, enabling learners to build real apps step by step. The course uses Next.js and MCP to bridge natural language and code, making it ideal for non-programmers or those new to AI agents. Try it to quickly prototype ideas or learn how to integrate AI into your workflow.

items.name: supersplat
items.summary: Supersplat 是一个基于浏览器的 3D 高斯泼溅编辑器。高斯泼溅是一种将场景表示为大量三维高斯分布的技术，能实现实时高质量渲染。该工具利用 WebGL 和 WebGPU 在浏览器中直接编辑、可视化和导出高斯泼溅模型，无需安装任何桌面软件。它基于 TypeScript 和 PlayCanvas 构建，提供直观的界面来操作泼溅点、裁剪场景、调整颜色和透明度等属性。你可以用它快速创建或优化 3D 场景，应用于虚拟现实、数字孪生或交互式可视化。其核心优势在于轻量级、跨平台，让 3D 编辑变得像网页浏览一样便捷。
items.summary_en: Supersplat is a web-based editor for 3D Gaussian Splatting, a technique that represents scenes as a collection of 3D Gaussians for real-time rendering. It enables intuitive editing, visualization, and export of Gaussian splat models directly in the browser using WebGL/WebGPU. Built with TypeScript and PlayCanvas, it offers a responsive UI for manipulating splats, cropping, and adjusting attributes. Developers can use it to create, refine, or inspect 3D scenes for applications like virtual reality, digital twins, or interactive visualizations without heavy desktop software.

items.name: agentmemory
items.summary: Agentmemory 是为 AI 编程代理设计的持久化记忆库，解决代理在多次会话间遗忘上下文的问题。其核心技术结合向量嵌入的语义召回与结构化元数据的精确检索，在基准测试中优于简单 RAG。开发者可将其集成到 Claude Code、Copilot 等代理中，实现跨会话的项目状态跟踪、bug 管理或功能开发。通过简单的 API 调用，代理能记住代码变更、用户偏好和任务进度，显著提升长周期协作效率。
items.summary_en: Agentmemory is a persistent memory library for AI coding agents, solving the problem of agents forgetting context across sessions. It uses a hybrid approach combining vector embeddings for semantic recall with structured metadata for precise retrieval, outperforming naive RAG in benchmarks. Developers can integrate it into agents like Claude Code or Copilot to maintain long-term project awareness, enabling tasks like bug tracking or feature development across multiple interactions.

items.name: MasterDnsVPN
items.summary: MasterDnsVPN 是一款先进的 DNS 隧道 VPN，旨在通过将数据封装在 DNS 查询中绕过网络审查。它在 DNSTT 和 SlipStream 的基础上进行了优化，引入了低开销的自动重传请求（ARQ）机制、解析器负载均衡以及在高丢包环境下的稳定性。使用 Go 语言编写，性能高效。你可以将其部署为客户端-服务器架构，通过 DNS 隧道传输任意 TCP 流量，非常适合在严格防火墙环境下实现快速且可靠的通信，同时保持较低的延迟和较高的吞吐量。
items.summary_en: MasterDnsVPN is an advanced DNS tunneling VPN designed to bypass censorship by encapsulating data in DNS queries. It improves upon DNSTT and SlipStream with a low-overhead Automatic Repeat-reQuest (ARQ) mechanism, resolver load balancing, and stability under high packet loss. Written in Go, it offers a fast and efficient tunnel. You can deploy it as a client-server setup to tunnel any TCP traffic through DNS, making it ideal for circumventing restrictive firewalls while maintaining speed and reliability.

items.name: oracle-ai-developer-hub
items.summary: Oracle AI Developer Hub 是一个面向AI开发者的技术资源集合，专注于利用Oracle数据库和OCI服务构建AI应用。它提供Jupyter笔记本、示例代码和教程，涵盖RAG、智能代理和生成式AI等主题。其核心优势在于与Oracle AI数据库的深度集成，支持向量搜索和数据库内机器学习，从而简化企业级AI应用的开发。开发者可以借鉴这些模式快速原型化聊天机器人、文档分析等应用，将企业数据与最新AI技术结合。对于希望利用现有Oracle基础设施扩展AI能力的团队，这是一个实用的起点。
items.summary_en: Oracle AI Developer Hub is a curated collection of technical resources for building AI applications with Oracle Database and OCI services. It features Jupyter notebooks, sample code, and tutorials covering RAG, agents, and generative AI. A key strength is its integration with Oracle AI Database for vector search and in-database ML. Developers can use these patterns to prototype AI-powered apps, from chatbots to document analysis, leveraging Oracle's scalable infrastructure. Ideal for teams wanting to combine enterprise data with modern AI workflows.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 是一个轻量级的 20 亿参数视觉语言模型，能够同时理解图像和文本，实现多模态对话与推理。其技术核心在于高效的跨模态融合架构，在保持较强推理能力的同时，模型尺寸足够小，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。开发者可通过 Hugging Face Transformers 直接调用该模型，应用于视觉问答、图像描述生成，或构建能够结合视觉内容与文本输入的交互式 AI 助手，为实际场景提供灵活的多模态解决方案。
items.summary_en: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct is a lightweight 2-billion-parameter vision-language model that enables conversational AI to understand and reason about both images and text simultaneously. Its technical innovation lies in efficient multimodal fusion architecture that maintains strong reasoning capabilities while being small enough for edge deployment. Developers can use it through Hugging Face Transformers for applications like visual question answering, image captioning, or building interactive AI assistants that process visual content alongside text inputs.

items.name: Kronos-Tokenizer-base
items.summary: Kronos-Tokenizer-base 是一个专为金融时间序列设计的标记器，能将原始的K线数据（开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价、成交量）转化为语言模型可理解的离散标记。其核心创新在于将市场微观结构编码为固定词汇表，使大语言模型能直接处理价格形态，无需手工特征工程。你可以用它预处理金融数据，用于价格预测、趋势分类或市场情绪分析；也可以扩展其词汇表，融入订单簿快照、新闻事件等另类数据，构建更丰富的金融AI应用。
items.summary_en: Kronos-Tokenizer-base is a specialized tokenizer for financial time series, converting raw candlestick data into tokens usable by language models. Its key innovation is encoding market microstructure (open, high, low, close, volume) into a discrete vocabulary, enabling LLMs to process price patterns directly. Use it to preprocess financial data for forecasting or sentiment analysis tasks, or extend it to incorporate alternative data like order book snapshots.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
